items.label: Intel Processor N150
items.value: This HP 14 inch laptop is powered by the efficient Intel N150 processor, featuring 4 cores, 4 threads, up to 3.6 GHz. This powerful chip ensures smooth multitasking, fast web browsing, and seamless photo/video editing for maximum productivity. Intel Graphics deliver vivid, realistic visuals for creative work and casual gaming

items.label: 14 Inch Laptop with HD Display
items.value: Enjoy sharp visuals on this HP laptop computer, featuring a 14" diagonal HD (1366 x 768) Anti-glare display with micro-edge BrightView and 250 nits brightness. The anti-glare panel reduces reflections, making it ideal for outdoor use. The HP 14 laptop also includes an HP True Vision 720p HD webcam with dual-array mics for crystal-clear video calls, even in low light

items.label: Upgraded RAM and Storage
items.value: Designed for efficiency, this HP business laptop comes with 16GB DDR4 RAM for effortless multitasking and 128GB UFS storage plus a 256GB Micro SD card for ample file space. Non-volatile storage ensures fast read/write speeds, while power gating enhances efficiency. With up to 12 hours of battery life, it’s perfect for professionals and students—making it a great HP student business laptop

items.label: Built for Speed & Connectivity
items.value: Stay connected with multiple ports, including USB Type-C (10Gbps), 2x USB Type-A, HDMI 1.4b, and an SD card reader. Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.4 ensure fast, stable connections. Whether for work or play, this HP 14 laptop keeps you flowing

items.label: Bundle with Microsoft Office Lifetime License and windows 11 Pro
items.value: Get your hands on Pre-installed windows 11 Pro and Microsoft Office lifetime license(For 1 PC) for free, forever, enhancing your office life with greater ease and efficiency! (Any upgrade issues please send message)
